id: title:Gilbert09:stream redshift reads via a server side cursor

review.posthog_relevance: Redshift warehouse ingestion and query execution, specifically addressing Out-Of-Memory (OOM) risks and performance on large tables.
review.reason: The observed changes implement a server-side cursor streaming mechanism (`_stream_arrow_batches`) and a catalog-based row size estimation, replacing client-side buffered reads and whole-row sampling.
